concept.hr: Otvoreni titrajni krug pušta polje u prostor: nastaje dipol
concept.en: Opening up a resonant circuit lets its field out into space: a dipole

summary.hr: Ploče kondenzatora razmiču se i rastvaraju, zavojnica se odmotava, dok ne ostane ravna žica: dipol. Električno polje izlazi iz kondenzatora u prostor.
summary.en: The capacitor's plates move apart and open up, the coil unwinds, until a straight wire is left: a dipole. The electric field leaves the capacitor for space.

what.hr: Aplet applet_schwingkreis_antenne.html (titrajni krug koji se otvara u dipol, u šest slika) i njegove slike 925–930 (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_schwingkreis_antenne.html (a resonant circuit opening up into a dipole, in six pictures) and its figures 925–930 (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

credits.by: 50ohm.de-Autorenteam, AJW-Referat des DARC e.V. (figures: Prof. Dr. Matthias Jung, DL9MJ)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, slike ponovno nacrtane kao SVG, dodani tekst na hrvatskom i engleskom, petlja slika postala 5 koraka sa sličicama svih oblika, dodani naboji, preklopnik za pola periode kasnije, pregled promjena L, C i f₀ i predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, the figures redrawn as SVG, text added in Croatian and English, the picture loop turned into 5 steps with thumbnails of all shapes, charges, a half-a-period-later switch, a summary of how L, C and f₀ change and presets added
